disabled.description: If true, the test will be skipped.

comparisonKeyFields.description:
Fields to construct a primary key from when comparing data.
This will default to `['id']` if not provided.

For cassandra types this may need to be set to ['parent', 'timestamp']
as ids are not sufficient primary keys to identify canonical data points.

Other edge cases may use this field as necessary where id is insufficient.

ignoreFields.description:
Fields to ignore when comparing data.  By default, the application looks for what fields are spec'd
in the expected files after being serialized into a type; in most cases, this will end up as just the
fields defined in the expected files.  However, in some cases, there may be fields that are not in them
depending on the type.

fetchAllPartitionedData.description:
Flag which indicates we should **fetch and clean up ALL data** for a partitioned type.
**This is a fallback option** which should be set only when a partitioned type
is being loaded **without its parent type**.

For example, if we have a canonical which only transform to {@link TimedDataPoint}
and does not transform to its parent {@link TimedDataHeader}, this flag must be set.

*Please set this flag with extreme caution as you run the risk of removing all data for this type*

title: The spec that describes how to run a test for a target type.
